prompt.project_info: Create a realistic vertical home lifestyle portrait of an original approved adult model relaxing on a modern sofa.
prompt.main_subject: An original approved adult woman with long wavy blonde hair, natural skin texture, light freckles, gold jewelry, and a friendly relaxed smile reclines comfortably on a dark gray textured sofa with one arm supporting her.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level side angle, yellow matching lounge set with a secure-coverage bandeau-style top and shorts, modern gray living room, paneled walls, warm wall sconce, framed abstract art, and a replaceable product-style graphic on the top.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused mixed indoor light with warm sconce glow and gentle window fill, cozy playful confident mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-realistic phone photography, vertical 2:3, 35mm or 50mm portrait perspective, sharp face and torso focus, subtle background blur, natural digital-camera grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic vertical UGC home lifestyle portrait of an original approved adult woman with long wavy blonde hair, natural skin texture, light freckles, and gold jewelry reclining comfortably on a dark gray textured sofa. She wears a yellow matching lounge set with a secure-coverage bandeau-style top and shorts. Modern gray living room with paneled walls, warm wall sconce, framed abstract art, and a replaceable product-style graphic on the top. Soft window fill mixed with warm ambient light, relaxed friendly expression, realistic phone photography, 2:3.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, childlike features, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, warped hands, unreadable text, watermark, brand-copying

assets.name: yellow lounge sofa reference
assets.usage: Match the adult subject's reclined pose, yellow outfit, gray sofa, wall paneling, and warm home lighting.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Keep identity, pose, outfit color story, sofa, room architecture, art placement, and lighting consistent. Identity, outfit, product, logo, environment, and typography elements must be replaceable; visible brand wording or artwork should be treated as editable placeholders.
